# OpenRep

OpenRep is a free, open-source, offline gym app for iOS and Android: workout
plans, a catalog of 870+ exercises, and a workout log. No account and no API.

Use this file to **write a workout plan the user can import into OpenRep**.
You produce one JSON document (a *plan file*); the user saves it and imports it
with **Plans → Import**. Nothing is replaced: the plan is added to their plans,
ready to edit and start.

- Plan file JSON Schema (draft 2020-12):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/s1n7ax/openrep/main/data/schema/plan.v1.json
- Exercise catalog (all exercises, their ids, muscles and equipment):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/s1n7ax/openrep/catalog/catalog.json
- Source of this file:
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/s1n7ax/openrep/main/llms.txt

## How to write a plan

1. Pick exercises from the catalog: use each `exercises[].id` as `exerciseId`.
   Never invent a catalog id — an id that does not exist still imports, but the
   app shows "No longer in catalog" and no photo or 3D view.
2. Lay the days out in the order they are trained. Put the work in a sensible
   order (compound lifts first), and give each exercise sets and either reps or
   a duration.
3. Choose weights only when the user told you what they lift, or asked for a
   starting weight; otherwise leave `weightKg` out and the app fills it from
   their history.
4. Optionally add form cues in `notes`.
5. Save the document as `openrep-plan-<name>.json` and tell the user to import
   it (step 3 below).

For an exercise that is not in the catalog, add it to `customExercises` and
refer to it with `kind: "custom"` (see the example). The app reuses an existing
custom exercise of the same name (ignoring case and spacing) instead of adding
a duplicate.

## The file

```text
{
  "app": "openrep",
  "kind": "plan",
  "formatVersion": 1,
  "plan": { … },
  "customExercises": [ … ]      // optional
}
```

Only these fields are allowed, at every level: an unknown field is an error.

### `plan`

| Field       | Type                | Description                                                     |
| ----------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`      | text                | Display name, e.g. `"Push/Pull/Legs"`.                          |
| `days`      | day[] (at least 1)  | Training days, in order.                                        |
| `id`        | string, optional    | Ignored: the app assigns a new id on import.                    |
| `createdAt` | timestamp, optional | Ignored: the app stamps the import time.                        |
| `updatedAt` | timestamp, optional | Ignored, as above.                                              |

### day

| Field       | Type                 | Description                                                    |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`      | text                 | Display name, e.g. `"Push"` or `"Upper A"`.                    |
| `exercises` | exercise[]           | In the order they are done. May be empty.                      |
| `supersets` | superset[], optional | The supersets the day's exercises belong to.                   |
| `id`        | string, optional     | Ignored.                                                       |

### exercise

| Field         | Type                | Description                                                                                   |
| ------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `exercise`    | reference           | The exercise: `{ "kind": "catalog", "exerciseId": …, "name": … }` or `{ "kind": "custom", "customExerciseId": …, "name": … }`. |
| `sets`        | integer, 1–20       | Number of sets (for a superset's exercise: sets per member per round).                        |
| `reps`        | string, optional    | A number (`"8"`) or an ascending range (`"8-12"`). Set exactly one of `reps`/`durationSec`.  |
| `durationSec` | integer, 1–3600     | Seconds held, for timed exercises such as a plank.                                            |
| `weightKg`    | number, 0–2000      | Starting weight in **kilograms** (decimals allowed). Leave out for bodyweight.               |
| `restSec`     | integer, 0–3600     | Rest after each set, in seconds.                                                              |
| `notes`       | string, optional    | Form cues or a reminder, shown under the exercise.                                            |
| `supersetId`  | string, optional    | The `id` of the superset this exercise belongs to.                                            |
| `id`          | string, optional    | Ignored.                                                                                      |

`name` on a reference is the display name; when a catalog `exerciseId` exists,
the app shows the catalog name instead.

### superset

Two or more exercises done alternately: one set of each, in order, makes a
round; the rest comes after each round.

| Field     | Type                | Description                                          |
| --------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | string              | Referenced by its exercises' `supersetId`.           |
| `restSec` | integer, 0–3600     | Rest after each round, in seconds. Optional.         |

A superset's exercises must be **next to each other** in `exercises` (the app
groups them only then), and every one of them needs the superset's `id` as
`supersetId`. Put `restSec` on the superset, not on its exercises.

### customExercise

| Field              | Type                | Description                                                                 |
| ------------------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`             | text                | Display name.                                                               |
| `id`               | string, optional    | Referenced by a custom exercise reference's `customExerciseId`.             |
| `notes`            | string, optional    | Form cues or a reminder.                                                    |
| `equipment`        | equipment or null   | `bands`, `barbell`, `body only`, `cable`, `dumbbell`, `e-z curl bar`, `exercise ball`, `foam roll`, `kettlebells`, `machine`, `medicine ball`, `other`. |
| `primaryMuscles`   | muscle[]            | `abdominals`, `abductors`, `adductors`, `biceps`, `calves`, `chest`, `forearms`, `glutes`, `hamstrings`, `lats`, `lower back`, `middle back`, `neck`, `quadriceps`, `shoulders`, `traps`, `triceps`. |
| `secondaryMuscles` | muscle[]            | As above.                                                                   |
| `instructions`     | string[]            | Step-by-step instructions, in order.                                        |
| `createdAt`        | timestamp, optional | Ignored.                                                                    |
| `updatedAt`        | timestamp, optional | Ignored.                                                                    |

## Rules that get files rejected

- Exactly one of `reps` and `durationSec` on every exercise; `reps` is a string.
- Weights are kilograms, not pounds (1 lb = 0.45359237 kg), and never `"60 kg"`.
- Text fields must not be empty or only whitespace.
- `sets` is 1–20, `durationSec` 1–3600, `restSec` 0–3600, `weightKg` 0–2000.
- No unknown fields, no comments, no trailing commas: plain JSON.
- Ids are opaque strings the app replaces; only superset ids need to match.

## Example

A two-day upper/lower plan with a superset, a timed exercise and one custom
exercise. It is a complete, valid file.

```json
{
  "app": "openrep",
  "kind": "plan",
  "formatVersion": 1,
  "plan": {
    "name": "Upper/Lower — 2 days a week",
    "days": [
      {
        "name": "Upper",
        "exercises": [
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "catalog",
              "exerciseId": "barbell-bench-press-medium-grip",
              "name": "Barbell Bench Press"
            },
            "sets": 4,
            "reps": "5",
            "weightKg": 72.5,
            "restSec": 180,
            "notes": "Two warm-up sets before the work sets."
          },
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "catalog",
              "exerciseId": "bent-over-barbell-row",
              "name": "Bent Over Barbell Row"
            },
            "sets": 4,
            "reps": "8-10",
            "weightKg": 60,
            "restSec": 120
          },
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "catalog",
              "exerciseId": "dumbbell-flyes",
              "name": "Dumbbell Flyes"
            },
            "sets": 3,
            "reps": "12",
            "weightKg": 14,
            "supersetId": "arms"
          },
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "catalog",
              "exerciseId": "triceps-pushdown",
              "name": "Triceps Pushdown"
            },
            "sets": 3,
            "reps": "12-15",
            "weightKg": 25,
            "supersetId": "arms"
          }
        ],
        "supersets": [
          {
            "id": "arms",
            "restSec": 90
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "Lower",
        "exercises": [
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "catalog",
              "exerciseId": "barbell-squat",
              "name": "Barbell Squat"
            },
            "sets": 3,
            "reps": "5",
            "weightKg": 90,
            "restSec": 180
          },
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "catalog",
              "exerciseId": "plank",
              "name": "Plank"
            },
            "sets": 3,
            "durationSec": 40,
            "restSec": 60
          },
          {
            "exercise": {
              "kind": "custom",
              "customExerciseId": "sled-push",
              "name": "Sled Push"
            },
            "sets": 4,
            "reps": "1",
            "restSec": 120,
            "notes": "20 m, heavy."
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "customExercises": [
    {
      "id": "sled-push",
      "name": "Sled Push",
      "notes": "Drive through the legs, arms straight.",
      "equipment": "other",
      "primaryMuscles": ["quadriceps", "glutes"],
      "secondaryMuscles": ["calves"],
      "instructions": ["Load the sled.", "Push it 20 m without stopping."]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Importing and exporting

1. Save the document as a `.json` file (for example
   `openrep-plan-upper-lower.json`) and send it to the user's phone or computer.
2. Export a real plan from the app for a reference or to personalize it: open
   the plan, then **Export** on the plan screen. That file uses this same
   format, weights included.
3. Import: **Plans** tab → **Import** → choose the file. The app validates it,
   adds it at the end of the plans and opens it. If the file is rejected, the
   app says the plan is damaged or incomplete; check it against the JSON Schema
   above.
